title: wayd-data recipe
description: A named bundle of generation knobs for wayd-data. Every field is optional: what a recipe leaves out is taken from the recipe it extends, and an explicit command-line flag beats both.

$schema.description: Points at this schema so an editor can complete and validate the file.

extends.description: A built-in recipe name or file path to start from. Anything stated here is layered over it.

description.description: A one-line summary, shown by `wayd-data recipes`.

timeline.description: When the run happens, and how far it reaches either side of that.

asOf.description: The date the run treats as today. Omit to anchor on the real one, so data straddles now. Pin it alongside --random-seed for byte-identical output.

companyAgeYears.description: How far back the company's history reaches. Nothing is generated before this.

teamStructureAgeYears.description: How long the current team structure has stood, which is shorter than the company's own age.

historyYears.description: How much delivery history sits behind asOf.

runwayYears.description: How much planned work sits ahead of asOf.

organization.description: The organization: people, teams, and the hierarchy over them.

enabled.description: Whether the area is generated at all.

companyType.description: Sets the default share of employees inside the delivery structure (tech ~85%, balanced ~50%, enterprise ~20%).

deliveryRatio.description: Override for that share, when the company type's default is not wanted.

formerEmployeeFraction.description: Fraction of non-delivery individual contributors generated as former employees.

users.description: The application roles and the sign-ins that hold them. Only people whose authorization differs get an account.

enabled.description: Whether roles and accounts are created at all.

password.description: The password every generated account is created with. Must satisfy the password rules: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

ppm.description: The portfolios, programs, projects and the work beneath them.

enabled.description: Whether the area is generated at all.

functionPortfolios.description: Cross-cutting business-function portfolios, in addition to one per value stream.

concurrentProjectsPerArt.description: Average number of projects an ART has in flight at once. The total generated is derived from this across the window.

concurrentProgramsPerPortfolio.description: Average number of thematic programs a portfolio runs at once.
